title: An improvement of Watson's theorem on Borel summability
note: The Nevanlinna–Sokal theorem: a function analytic on a disc tangent to the imaginary axis with Gevrey-1 remainder bounds is uniquely recovered by Borel resummation. Cited as the target theorem of the QOU/Mathlib/BorelResummation gap-infra programme (bean el8w): hypothesis half (i) — Gevrey-1 implies Borel-disc convergence — is formalized sorry-free; the Laplace resummation + uniqueness half remains the documented gap.
